notes.title: Patch v0.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes V0.2
-- Fixed some bugs, when the player marked an anomaly by clicking on the wall, where previously stood a painting that moved to another place and the player had to start the game again.
-- Changed the volume of some sounds / Added new sounds.
-- It is no longer possible to fall off the map at the introductory level.
-- Added some hints in the introductory level.
-- Added Spot Light to a bonus level with a monster that points in his direction.
-- Cut the time between turning off the light and moving to the bonus location.

notes.title: Patch v0.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes V0.2
-- Fixed some bugs, when the player marked an anomaly by clicking on the wall, where previously stood a painting that moved to another place and the player had to start the game again.
-- Changed the volume of some sounds / Added new sounds.
-- It is no longer possible to fall off the map at the introductory level.
-- Added some hints in the introductory level.
-- Added Spot Light to a bonus level with a monster that points in his direction.
-- You can no longer continuously dance and walk at the same time.
-- Cut the time between turning off the light and moving to the bonus location.
